description: If you do anything this year, make sure you protest your taxes. I'm looking at you Temple, Killeen, Belton, Salado, Harker Heights, and Copperas Cove. Less than 25% of people protest their Texas property taxes and all it should cost you is time and maybe some data from a real estate professional (commercial excluded). More to come on this but let this be a warning.
